newsitem.title: USA: Cablevision declines comment on ITT rumors.
newsitem.headline: Cablevision declines comment on ITT rumors.

text.p: Cablevision Systems Corp, viewed as a potential buyer of ITT Corp's 50 percent stake in Madison Square Garden and related properties, said it declined to comment on rumors or speculation about transactions.

"We have noted previously that Cablevision enjoys an excellent relationship with (ITT chairman) Rand Araskog and ITT. We stated then that the Madison Square Garden properties are important assets for Cablevision and that we will maintain our ownership position in these entities," the company said in a press release.

Cablevision owns the other 50 percent of the Madison Square Garden properties, which include the arena, the New York Knicks professional basketball team, the New York Rangers professional hockey team and additional assets.
ITT and Cablevision entered the partnership in 1995 and Cablevision has the right of first refusal if ITT wants to sell its stake.
ITT earlier rejected a hostile $6.5 billion bid from Hilton Hotels Corp. ITT said it would consider "monetizing" its non core assets.
